uslaw-usc-t2-s132a1: Section 132a-1 of Title 2 limits Library of Congress obligations for reimbursable and revolving fund activities to the total amounts provided for them. The limit took effect for fiscal years beginning with fiscal year 1995. Amounts may come from the annual regular appropriations act for the legislative branch. A supplemental appropriations act for the legislative branch may supply the amounts instead. The section sits in Chapter 5, the Library of Congress chapter of Title 2.
